style.styleTitle: Personalised Couples Foiled Wreath and Banners Engagement Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: An intricate glass bauble to celebrate a recent engagement. Featuring a metallic foiled, illustrated wreath design and two banners with personalised text. The banners on the design can be personalised with any text of your choosing and will be printed exactly as per the text entered on your order. The design is printed in a metallic foil onto a clear polyester sheet, inserted into the bauble, which is finished with a grosgrain hanging ribbon in a choice of colours. The bauble measures approximately 8 x 8cm.
